If you develop chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting, or stroke-like weakness or speech trouble, call 911; new dizziness or swelling needs clinician review.

citations.claim: High blood pressure is defined by consistent systolic readings of 130 mm Hg or higher or diastolic of 80 mm Hg or higher, so a single 122/78 home reading is below that threshold.
citations.limitation: Patient education thresholds require consistent readings; only one home reading was reported and technique is unknown.
